decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical absolute ROM BIOS screen-data definitions.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
COMMAND DIR and TCMD2A and BIOS SYSINIT2 include rombios.inc and refer to CRT_Cols or CRT_Rows.
The prior DIR comparison matched 2114 non-relocation bytes and 78 internal branches at an inferred target location (review 122).
limitations: Module comparison excludes relocation fields and does not establish every configuration or final absolute reference. Complete BIOS and COMMAND links remain unverified.
